How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 8.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, hyper-realistic photography, the eighteen-year-old cultivation junior disciple with a doll-like face, sweet playful smile, black hair in an ancient-style bun secured by a wooden hairpin, wearing a bright red embroidered wide-sleeve robe with a red cord and white jade pendant at her waist, begins in the close-up facial framing and soft celestial lighting established by Picture 1, smiling warmly toward the camera. She remains completely stationary, raising her right hand and pointing to the right side of the frame. The camera performs a fast pan right with large amplitude, swinging away from her toward the direction she points, her figure sliding out to the left edge of the frame as the lens whips around. A rush of wind accompanies the motion. As the camera reaches the apex of the swing and decelerates smoothly, the colossal Heavenly Gate sweeps into view — dozens of towering crimson carved wooden pillars, white jade mythical-beast pedestal bases, and soaring dougong eaves emerging from the sea of clouds. Golden dawn light pierces through the cloud layers, casting shifting beams across the gate, while clouds churn and flow over the platform. Distant immortal palaces float upon the cloud tides. The camera settles into the low-angle grand composition, overwhelming scale, lighting, and solemn atmosphere established by Picture 2 at the end of the shot. The young woman (S1), her voice following the reference audio, says: <d>[Chinese] 欢迎来到青云宗！眼前便是宗门的天阙巨山门！</d>

overall_soundscape: A sharp whoosh of rushing air cuts through the scene as the camera pans fast to the right, followed by the deep resonant roar of the cloud sea and faint ethereal temple bell tones echoing from the colossal gate. Robes and hair rustle softly in the celestial breeze before the swing.

non_diegetic_music: A quick taiko drum accent marks the pan motion, then sustained low strings and a solo bamboo flute at a slow, majestic tempo swell as the gate is revealed, before fading gently.
